subject: Insurance
title: Term Life: Simple and Cheap
description: A micro-lesson that makes Term Life: Simple and Cheap usable.

hook.text: Term life insures you for a set period—10, 20, or 30 years. If you die during the term, it pays.

buildup.text: Term life is the cheapest option. A healthy 30-year-old can get $500,000 of coverage for about $25 a month.

discovery.text: About 99% of term policies never pay out. Most people outlive their term. That's why it's so affordable.

twist.text: The insurance industry profits massively from term life. Millions pay premiums for decades and the insurer keeps it all.

climax.text: Term life is pure protection—no savings, no investment. Pay for the risk you need, nothing more.

punchline.text: 99% never pay out. Term life is cheap because most people survive.

quiz.question: What happens if you outlive your term life policy?
